Can an open-source modelling stack satisfy the four EIF layers (legal, organisational, semantic, technical) when its result schema, configuration grammar and orchestration are designed as contracts rather than as artefacts?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="370" x="60" y="156" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rq2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0A3DA3;strokeColor=#0A3DA3;fontSize=11;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingRight=12;verticalAlign=middle;" value="RQ2 — Dual-use qualification

Does such a stack qualify as a dual-use technology under EU Reg. 2021/821 — usable for civilian decarbonisation studies and equally for defence-relevant resilience assessments — while remaining within the regulation's public-domain carve-out?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="370" x="440" y="156" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rq3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0A3DA3;strokeColor=#0A3DA3;fontSize=11;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingRight=12;verticalAlign=middle;" value="RQ3 — Funding alignment

Do contemporary EU instruments (Horizon Europe Cluster 5, European Defence Fund, Connecting Europe Facility, rescEU) already foresee this dual orientation so that a platform internalising the EIF obligations can be co-funded across instruments without architectural duplication?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="370" x="820" y="156" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow1" edge="1" parent="1" source="rq1" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#5D6A7B;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontColor=#5D6A7B;" target="finding1" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow2a" edge="1" parent="1" source="rq2" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#5D6A7B;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontColor=#5D6A7B;" target="finding2" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow2b" edge="1" parent="1" source="rq2" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#5D6A7B;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontColor=#5D6A7B;" target="proposal1" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow3" edge="1" parent="1" source="rq3" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;strokeColor=#5D6A7B;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontColor=#5D6A7B;" target="proposal2" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sec_band" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#5D6A7B;strokeColor=#5D6A7B;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;" value="ANSWERED IN" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="1130" x="60" y="324" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sec_rq1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF5FF;strokeColor=#C7D5EF;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1E2B3A;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;fontStyle=2;" value="§3 Platform architecture

§5 Dual-use applicability" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="370" x="440" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="sec_rq3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF5FF;strokeColor=#C7D5EF;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1E2B3A;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;fontStyle=2;" value="§6 Contemporary funding mechanisms" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="370" x="820" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fp_band" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#072A75;strokeColor=#072A75;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=center;" value="FINDINGS AND PROPOSALS (Conclusions)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="1130" x="60" y="408" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="finding1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F7B3B;strokeColor=#0F7B3B;fontSize=10;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingRight=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="FINDING 1

A six-layer architecture for paired-scenario stress testing is feasible on an open substrate. Presentation, API, Domain Logic, Workflow and Optimisation, Persistence and External Data layers assembled around PyPSA-Eur and a Next.js dashboard, without modifying the optimisation core. Paired baseline+stressed run with comparison report in 20–25 min at 20 clusters, hourly resolution. Candidate substrate for national risk-assessment work under Directive (EU) 2022/2557." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="270" x="60" y="444" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="finding2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F7B3B;strokeColor=#0F7B3B;fontSize=10;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingRight=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="FINDING 2

Compact orthogonal shocks already produce CER-Directive-grade evidence. Five orthogonal channels — load multiplier, hydro reduction, gas capacity reduction, SCADA-proxy ramp constraints, directional import caps — combine into an envelope interpretable for resilience decision-making. Moderate simultaneous derating with electrical isolation produces order-of-magnitude signals: 45 GWh ENS, +31% cost, 2× LMP. Compact shock taxonomies are sufficient as the measurement instrument." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="270" x="345" y="444" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="proposal1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F28C28;strokeColor=#F28C28;fontSize=10;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingRight=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="PROPOSAL 1

Add a governance layer to the European Interoperability Framework for critical-infrastructure modelling. A fifth cross-cutting layer bundling persistent job state, immutable templates, per-run logs, and a machine-readable assumptions-and-limitations object into a verifiable audit envelope. Interoperability becomes a property that can be audited, not only claimed — the threshold a national risk assessment under the CER Directive must meet to be admissible." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="270" x="630" y="444" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="proposal2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F28C28;strokeColor=#F28C28;fontSize=10;fontStyle=0;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingRight=10;verticalAlign=middle;" value="PROPOSAL 2

Make civilian-by-design platforms the default substrate for cross-pillar EU funding in critical-infrastructure security. A single-substrate posture lets Horizon Europe Cluster 5, EDF, CEF and rescEU finance complementary deliverables of one architecture instead of four parallel architectures, satisfying the public-domain carve-out under Reg. (EU) 2021/821 by construction. Recommended as an explicit eligibility criterion in the next work-programme cycle." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="275" x="915" y="444" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend_finding" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#0F7B3B;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontStyle=1;" value="■ Evidenced finding (supported by §3–§6 of the paper)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="500" x="60" y="702" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend_proposal" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#F28C28;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontStyle=1;" value="■ Forward-looking proposal (call to action for EU policy / EIF revision)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="560" x="630" y="702" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=9;fontColor=#5D6A7B;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontStyle=2;" value="Source: authors. Mapping consolidates the three claims previously stated in the Introduction into the structure requested by Reviewer 1 — research questions in the Introduction, evidenced findings and proposals in the Conclusions." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="1130" x="60" y="728" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
RQ1 — Interoperability
Can an open-source modelling stack satisfy the four EIF layers (legal, organisational, semantic, technical) when its result schema, configuration grammar and orchestration are designed as contracts rather than as artefacts?

div.div:
RQ2 — Dual-use qualification
Does such a stack qualify as a dual-use technology under EU Reg. 2021/821 — usable for civilian decarbonisation studies and equally for defence-relevant resilience assessments — while remaining within the regulation's public-domain carve-out?

div.div:
FINDING 1
A six-layer architecture for paired-scenario stress testing is feasible on an open substrate. Presentation, API, Domain Logic, Workflow and Optimisation, Persistence and External Data layers assembled around PyPSA-Eur and a Next.js dashboard, without modifying the optimisation core. Paired baseline+stressed run with comparison report in 20–25 min at 20 clusters, hourly resolution. Candidate substrate for national risk-assessment work under Directive (EU) 2022/2557.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 534px; margin-left: 317px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
FINDING 2
Compact orthogonal shocks already produce CER-Directive-grade evidence. Five orthogonal channels — load multiplier, hydro reduction, gas capacity reduction, SCADA-proxy ramp constraints, directional import caps — combine into an envelope interpretable for resilience decision-making. Moderate simultaneous derating with electrical isolation produces order-of-magnitude signals: 45 GWh ENS, +31% cost, 2× LMP. Compact shock taxonomies are sufficient as the measurement instrument.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 248px; height: 1px; padding-top: 534px; margin-left: 602px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
PROPOSAL 1
Add a governance layer to the European Interoperability Framework for critical-infrastructure modelling. A fifth cross-cutting layer bundling persistent job state, immutable templates, per-run logs, and a machine-readable assumptions-and-limitations object into a verifiable audit envelope. Interoperability becomes a property that can be audited, not only claimed — the threshold a national risk assessment under the CER Directive must meet to be admissible.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 253px; height: 1px; padding-top: 534px; margin-left: 887px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
PROPOSAL 2
Make civilian-by-design platforms the default substrate for cross-pillar EU funding in critical-infrastructure security. A single-substrate posture lets Horizon Europe Cluster 5, EDF, CEF and rescEU finance complementary deliverables of one architecture instead of four parallel architectures, satisfying the public-domain carve-out under Reg. (EU) 2021/821 by construction. Recommended as an explicit eligibility criterion in the next work-programme cycle.
